stem_book: A metal sphere is hung by a string fixed to a wall. The sphere is pushed away from the wall by a stick. The forces acting on the sphere are shown in the second diagram (tension T along the string at angle θ to the vertical, horizontal push P, weight W). Which of the following statements is wrong? (a) P = W tanθ (b) T̄ + P̄ + W̄ = 0 (c) T² = P² + W² (d) T̄ = P̄ + W̄
work: equilibrium ⇒ T̄ + P̄ + W̄ = 0 (b true) ⇒ Tcosθ = W, Tsinθ = P ⇒ P = Wtanθ, T² = P² + W² true; T̄ = P̄ + W̄ contradicts (b) ⇒ d wrong
